name: peregon
description: A visual data pipeline builder powered by Vue 3, WebGPU, and Rust/WebAssembly.

scripts.wasm:dev: wasm-pack build wasm --mode no-install --target web --dev --no-opt --out-dir ../src/generated/peregon_engine --out-name peregon_engine -- --locked --offline
scripts.wasm:release: wasm-pack build wasm --mode no-install --target web --release --no-opt --out-dir ../src/generated/peregon_engine --out-name peregon_engine -- --locked --offline
scripts.dev: npm run wasm:dev && npm run syntax:build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vite dev
scripts.build: npm run wasm:release && npm run typecheck && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vite build
scripts.build:pages: npm run wasm:release && npm run typecheck && GITHUB_PAGES=true vite build
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml --locked --offline && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
